# `cache` command

Manage the FoBiS build artifact cache.

```bash
fobis cache <subcommand> [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Building](/cookbook/build).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis cache clean`

Purge stale cache entries.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--older-than` | INTEGER |  | Delete entries older than N days |
| `--cache-dir` | TEXT |  | Cache directory to clean |

### `fobis cache list`

List all cached builds with metadata.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cache-dir` | TEXT |  | Cache directory to inspect |

### `fobis cache show`

Show cache status for a specific dependency.

Arguments: `DEP_NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cache-dir` | TEXT |  | Cache directory to inspect |

<!-- cli:end -->
